d: A prominent organisation operating within Qatar’s financial services ecosystem is seeking an experienced Legal Counsel – Commercial to join its Legal Department.

The successful candidate will provide proactive, commercially focused legal advice across corporate, commercial, regulatory, policy and legislative matters. The role will also support strategic legal projects, stakeholder engagement and dispute resolution.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law from a reputable university in a common law jurisdiction.
Professional admission to a recognised Law Society or equivalent body.
6 years of relevant legal experience within an international law firm, financial services organisation, government body or similar in-house environment.
Strong corporate, commercial and regulatory drafting capabilities.
Experience negotiating commercial agreements and advising on financial services regulations.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
High standards of professionalism, ethics and confidentiality
